about: A log out that completes, as a Mac's (docs/adr/0064-sleep-restart-shut-down-and-log-out.mdx), with the session's shell and an application whose document is saved (sample/QuitProbe.tsx, launched as Allo), over logind played on the run's own bus (never the machine's). Shift+Super+Q asks, the keyboard on Log Out; Return logs out: the application is asked to quit, agrees and ends its process, and once it is gone the session ends (`logged_out`), letting logind's handle-power-key inhibitor go, which logind then holds for nobody; logind is asked to restart, shut down or sleep nothing. With the session ending before the application has gone, or never, or asking logind anything, the run fails.

steps.name: Save: nothing unsaved, so the application will agree to quit; the session holds the power key's inhibitor
Shift+Super+Q: the question to log out, its countdown, the keyboard on Log Out; nothing asked yet
